kevin: FYI CI linkcheck flagged /guides/cli#Install-> 404. looks like the heading was `Install` in the old site but migrated examples used inline code and mkdocs slugged it to `install-cli` :grimace: gao: ah, another slugifier mismatch. docusaurus used a different algorithm so fragments like `CLI.install` turned into `cli.install` vs mkdocs `cli-install`. may: short-term: add an explicit id on the heading and a tiny legacy anchor so external links keep working. e.g. `

Install

` kevin: agreed. I'll open a micro-PR that touches docs/guides/cli.md and also normalize the code fence language tags (`sh` -> `bash`). gaо: please include the original failing line from linkcheck in the PR so reviewers see what broke. kevin: pasted linkcheck snippet in PR:``` ERROR: /guides/cli#CLI.install -> 404 (anchor not found) ``` may: nice. also add a one-line note to CONTRIBUTING.md under "anchors" recommending the dual-anchor pattern when migrating from older sites. saves churn later. link-bot: Netlify preview requested for branch docs/cli-anchor-fix (build 100222). preview-bot: Preview available: https://deploy-preview-100222--docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/cli - anchors clickable. docsbot: automated checks: linkcheck ✅, markdownlint ✅, accessibility ⚠️ (low contrast in example table) may: filed issue #1330 for the contrast fix and linked it in the PR description. non-blocking. kevin: merged after 2x LGTM. follow-up: infra team, can we add a nightly linkcheck against main so migrations surface earlier? gaо: created infra issue and linked it in the PR. may: thanks everyone, closing thread. :wave:
